history.summary: Bhabatarini Mandir at Kumarghat was founded in 1981 on the occasion of Shivachaturdashi, per the official Unakoti district website. The complex includes an Eco-Kid park, a temple of god Shiva, and an idol of Lord Buddha near the main Bhabatarini temple. Thousands of devotees from across the region visit during Shiva Chaturdashi and Kali Puja. The temple lies within Kumarghat town, 26 km from the district headquarters Kailashahar. Distinct from the Maa Bhabatarini Temple at Kalishashon near Kailashahar (seq 1051) - similar name, different site.

name: Bhabatarini Mandir, Kumarghat
town_description: Kumarghat is a town in Unakoti district, northern Tripura, about 26 km south of Kailashahar on the rail line to Agartala. It is a local commercial centre with several small temples, including the Bhabatarini complex and nearby Unakoti-region pilgrimage sites.

travel.airport: Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport, Agartala (~160 km by road)
travel.railway: Kumarghat Railway Station, within the town (~108 km from Agartala rail station)
travel.road: Within Kumarghat town; buses and small vehicles connect to Guwahati, Silchar, Shillong and Agartala

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Shiva Chaturdashi (Feb/March) and Kali Puja are the peak pilgrimage periods
visitor_information.opening_hours: Reported open daily 9:30 AM - 8:30 PM (single source - verify locally)
